User Experience Design Program
Program
Co-ordinator:
Bruce Gillespie, MA,
bgillespie@wlu.ca
The User Experience Design (UX) BDes degree provides
students with an interdisciplinary liberal arts background for mastery of all
aspects of user-centred design, and qualifies graduates as user experience
design practitioners or consultants in website and application development, as
well as immersive and non-digital environments.
